body:
My light side - Chadra-Fans of Hades

My dark side - Destroyer Droids of Hades



Both my deck lists can be found in my profile.



GAME 1

My DARK vs. Daryl’s LIGHT Profit deck



Daryl didn’t seem to have a very organized deck. He everything ranging from mains to systems and sites. He even set up Cloud City Celebration at one point. Anyway, he put a couple mains down at the Audience Chamber and freed Han. I dropped down with three Destroyer Droids, shot Han, shot whoever else was there and forfeited the Destroyers (that was the whole point). He could not longer Force drain on Tatooine and I just canceled his drains at Kessel using Where Are Those Droidekas (which also pulled my destroyers out for me ^_^ ). I dropped down on any squad he put down and overwhelmed him with weapon hit damage. Easy win.



FW by 28

+2(+28)



GAME 2

My LIGHT vs. Daryl’s DARK Carbon Chamber Testing deck



Hmmm...Daryl again, eh? No matter. My Chadra-Fan deck had no Rebels so he instantly flipped. He did not know the wrath of my Chadra-Fan deck so he deployed unwisely. I dropped Sandwhirl on the Hutt Trade Route sending Dr. Evazan & Ponda Boba and Vader with saber missing. He deployed at my Death Star docking bay so I dropped and stomped there. My Tessek Force drain booster really overwhelmed him. Another easy win.



FW by 25

+4(+53)



GAME 3

My DARK vs. Perry’s LIGHT Watch Your Step deck



Watch Your Step? I’ll do that. First turn, I slap down the Blockade Flagship: Bridge! And I put Nute Gunray there! YEEHAW! Excellent start so far. I take over the Cantina quickly with P-60 and two destroyers. He deploys to Kessel. I stop his mean drains with my effect. I deploy two destroyers to the docking bay. He comes down with Luke with saber and Chewie with gun. I play Master, Destroyers on Luke and play Oh, Switch Off when Chewie targets me. I hit both of his dudes. Crossfire kicks in of course. He loses everything. I forfeit one guy to attrition. I reinforce that area a bit. He has Battle Plan down. Ouch. I retrieve about 8 force using Abyssin Ornament for free (he didn’t have Aim High). He cancels my Cantina drains with some interrupts (I forgot its title). He deploys to docking bay after having a Kessel Run retrieval canceled (he didn’t save any for my Secret Plans). I initiate there and I am attacked by Fallen Portal. I save my droids with Oh, Switch Offs and resume fighting. I shoot a couple of his guys and get attritionized to death there. I never manage to take the docking bay over again so his drains are free now. He keeps canceling my Cantina drain with that interrupt that I forgot its name to. I can’t hang on and he barely kills me.



FL by 2

+4(+51)



GAME 4

My LIGHT vs. Mikal’s DARK Death Star II Occupational deck



This is not my day. Mikal knows my Chadra-Fan deck INSIDE and OUT! It’s not fair! He avoids my Chadra-Fans and uses Darth Maul to restrain them. Not much to tell...he occupies me to death...can’t...stop...it...



FL by 15

+4(+36)



Believe it or not, I took third! Woohoo! I later refined my dark deck to have two After Hers! I play tested on Mikal and it retrieves very nicely! Woohoo! Resistance also saved my hide.
title: Richland Washington 03-30-2002
author: Kelly Brown

games.opponent_objective: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed
Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration
Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough

summary: Kelly Brown finished 3rd at a tournament in Richland, Washington, on 30 March 2002 with a Chadra-Fan deck and a Destroyer Droid deck, going 2–2 (4 (+36)).
notes: Place and date only from the report title ('Richland Washington 03-30-2002'); the body names no store, player count or winner.
All opponents are given by first name only (Daryl twice, Perry, Mikal).

The report says both deck lists are in his DeckTech profile. His live list [[Kelly Brown Gyro LSCDD v1 0]] (posted 25 March 2002; Let Them Make The First Move, 16 Destroyer Droids, Blockade Flagship: Bridge, Nute Gunray, P-60, Where Are Those Droidekas?!, Abyssin Ornament, Resistance shield) looks like the Destroyer Droids of Hades deck, but the title differs and he refined the deck afterwards, so deck_page and objective are left null.
Format Premiere - Theed Palace: no virtual cards appear in the report (the Gyro LSCDD page is labelled Premiere - Original VS1 by posting date only).
Mikal's 'Death Star II Occupational deck' is not linked to an objective (vague).
